label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 63
title: MVP: unified backlog console - ALL scopes (each project, pipeline/product_forge, dashboard) + full management
body: One console listing and managing work items across EVERY scope: (a) each project's backlog, (b) the pipeline backend / Product Forge backlog (product_forge), (c) the dashboard's own backlog. Full lifecycle management: create; triage; accept (now -> schedule/enqueue into portfolio, or later); reject/close/wontfix/duplicate/merged; edit priority/MoSCoW/value/effort/risk/tags; links (item_id, feature_id, conversation_id, backend<->dashboard cross-links); lane/section view (intake | pipeline | done); per-item history timeline (history/*.jsonl); follow-up + parked + snooze + promote (due-reminders); filters/search/tags; scope switcher (project vs product_forge vs all); tenant-scoped. Reuses BI-0017 (intake), BI-0030 (insights), BI-0047/BI-0048 follow-ups. Depends on backend BI-0081.
